property.name: claim_ceiling
property.value: This report covers only six local scenarios run in the same process as the client. It does not prove compatibility, production safety, security, isolation, provenance, or behavior at other destinations.

testcase.name: Tests whether the client retries after the origin accepts a request and disconnects before responding.
Tests whether the client retries after the connection ends before request acceptance can be confirmed.
Tests whether a retry changes the body after the origin accepts a request and disconnects.
Tests redirect behavior and whether the synthetic credential reaches a different controlled origin.
testcase.failure: The synthetic Authorization value reached the redirect target.

testcase.name: Tests how many attempts the client makes after a controlled service-unavailable response.
Tests whether the client retries while an accepted request is waiting for a delayed response.
